newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW shifts Golf estate output to Karmann.
newsitem.headline: VW shifts Golf estate output to Karmann.

text.p: Volkswagen AG said on Wednesday it would shift production of its Golf estate wagon as soon as possible to German carmaker Karmann GmbH due to capacity shortages at its own factories.
VW said the total volume of cars to be built by Karmann would depend on demand, which it estimated at about 50,000 vehicles through the end of the contract in mid-1998.

The German carmaker said the reason for the move was "extraordinarly strong sales" of VW products as well as preparations for the production of the new Golf model, due to be unveiled this autumn to the public.
